question: Duleep Trophy is a first class _________ tournament held in India.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Cricket.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__Duleep Trophy:__

__
 
• The Duleep Trophy, also known as the Mastercard Duleep Trophy due to sponsorship reasons, is a domestic first-class cricket competition played in India.
 
• Named after Kumar Shri Duleepsinhji of Nawanagar (also known as 'Duleep'), the competition was originally contested by teams representing geographical zones of India.
 
• The competition was started by the Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) in the 1961–62 season.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__2022 Duleep Trophy__

__
 
• The West zone defeated the South zone by 294 runs to win their 19th title on the final day of the 2022 Duleep Trophy.__
